Subject: Final adjudication: Senior Backend Candidate - Diego Gonzalez

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround on interviews yesterday. We need one short push to close this loop and decide whether to move Diego to offer. Please do the following by EOD:

- Drop your numeric score (1-5) and a 1-2 line rationale in reply.
- Flag any hard-blocker or issue we should discuss live.

I started a compiled scorecard and attached it (gonzalez-scorecard-compiled.pdf). I will run a 30m adjudication call at 4pm PT if we don’t reach unanimous alignment in thread. If you can’t make the call, reply with your score and whether you recommend hire / no hire / hold.

Quick context: strong systems design, good product judgment, one flag on long-tail perf testing coverage per Mina. Candidate is from a payments-scale background; role needs someone who can own production SLAs across multi-region GNUs.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: gonzalez-scorecard-compiled.pdf, interview-notes-20270524.docx

Marcus —

Score: 4
Recommendation: Hire
Rationale: Clean system design, called out trade-offs on KV-cache consistency vs latency and gave reasonable mitigation. Pairing exercise showed solid debugging chops. No hard blocker.

Quick note: asked about load-testing at 99.9p; candidate described an approach using synthetic tails + event replay which is sufficient for our bar.

Attached: my completed rubic (see inline score section).

— Soojin

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Final adjudication: Senior Backend Candidate - Diego Gonzalez

Score: 3
Recommendation: Hold for follow-up

Rationale: Solid answers overall but I have an implementation concern on long-tail perf validation and monitoring. In the systems design he suggested replication + async repair for hot keys — that's fine for eventual correctness but we need a concrete plan for "how we know" at scale (synthetic tail tests are not enough for us if they don't touch production-like traffic patterns).

If we proceed, I want a short take-home (1–2 day) where candidate shows an approach to instrumenting and validating a KV hotspot under mixed workloads, or we schedule a short technical follow-up with an infra-focused engineer.

Not a blocker for culture or debugging skills, but it matters for the on-call handover timeline.

— Mina

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:02:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Final adjudication: Senior Backend Candidate - Diego Gonzalez

Thanks for the notes. I pulled the panel inputs into the compiled PDF (attached). Current tally: Soojin 4 (hire), Marissa 4 (lean hire), Mina 3 (hold), Neha (pending).

Proposal: given the split, let's do the following before 4pm PT adjudication call:
- Neha, can you share your score and any TL-level concerns?
- Marcus, can you confirm if recruiting has flexibility on start date / level (IC3 vs IC4) if we want to structure a ramped offer?

If we can move to hire-with-condition (follow-up verification or short take-home assignment) I think we can keep momentum and not lose Diego. I’ve attached a calendar invite (cal-invite-adjudication.ics) for 4:00–4:30pm PT.

— Marissa (Recruiting Partner)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: talent-ops@hireflow.io
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 17:04:01 -0700
Subject: Re: Final adjudication: Senior Backend Candidate - Diego Gonzalez

Score: 4
Recommendation: Hire (with short verification)

I sketched out a light-weight verification path:
- Offer at IC3 with standard comp band; contingent on a short 48-hour technical check (remote exercise or recorded demo) focused on hotspot instrumentation + validation.
- Recruiting to present the contingency in the offer, with a 2-week window to complete.

Rationale: Diego showed strong product sense and the right debugging instincts. Mina's concern is valid — we should require demonstrable attention to production validation. This gives us a way to hire quickly while de-risking the long-tail gap.

Next steps (action items):
- Marcus: confirm headcount and preferred start date for offer.
- Marissa: prepare conditional offer language and send to talent-ops (cc'd).
- Mina: draft a 48-hour verification prompt or identify an infra engineer to run the follow-up.

I support moving forward on that basis.

— Neha
